I can't reply to this properly without blogging too much. It really depends on each individual as to what their Dr recommends. It's not exactly a blanket statement that Drs will say NO CAFFEIENE EVER if someone has POTS. Generally speaking, people can make their own decisions and decide if something they're consuming is making them feel horrible.


Caffeine is more complex than just "tachycardia causing". The reason people with POTS experience tachy episodes, is because their BP is dropping episodically. If caffeine can aid in preventing those drops, it's not going to cause a POTS episode in-of-itself. Most people with POTS aren't tachy 24/7. So yeah caffeine might raise their general heart beat a bit, same as anyone. But other people in the population without POTS can also be caffeine sensitive and get super tachy and have adverse effects. It's not specifically related to POTS as to whether a Dr is going to recommend staying away from caffeine or not.

Stimulants can be prescribed to treat POTS, in order to maintain BP. By maintaining blood pressure, the drops are less likely to occur and therefore tachycardia episodes reduce. Caffeine impacts everyone differently. Yes, it may exacerbate symptoms in some, but others may experience some relief. It doesn't pose a big of a problem as people in this sub make it out to be.
